notes.title: Thanks for playing the demo!
notes.content:
Thanks for your interest in HELI 100 and trying out the demo! 
Just a quick note: we're also working on another game that's called PAKO 4. It's quite different to this although it too has twin-stick action gameplay elements.

If you want to check it out, click here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3425320/PAKO_4/] PAKO 4 Steam page [/url]
